phases.name: Walking Skeleton
phases.description: Thinnest E2E slice through flagzen-spring: Gradle module, auto-configuration discovery, FlagProvider-to-FeatureDispatcher wiring, proxy bean registration, and runtime dispatch through Spring DI. Proves the entire auto-configuration pipeline works end-to-end.

steps.name: Inject feature proxy and dispatch to active variant via Spring DI
steps.description: Set up flagzen-spring Gradle submodule with build.gradle.kts (api on flagzen-core, implementation on spring-boot-autoconfigure), add module to settings.gradle.kts, create FlagZenAutoConfiguration with @AutoConfiguration, create FeatureProxyRegistrar with ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar, create AutoConfiguration.imports resource, wire acceptance test infrastructure with spring-boot-starter-test and Cucumber Spring integration. One FlagProvider bean in, one injected proxy dispatching out.
criteria: settings.gradle.kts includes flagzen-spring
flagzen-spring/build.gradle.kts exists with api dependency on flagzen-core and implementation dependency on spring-boot-autoconfigure
FlagZenAutoConfiguration exists in com.flagzen.spring with @AutoConfiguration annotation
FlagZenAutoConfiguration creates FeatureDispatcher bean from FlagProvider with @ConditionalOnMissingBean guard
FlagZenAutoConfiguration imports FeatureProxyRegistrar via @Import
FeatureProxyRegistrar implements ImportBeanDefinitionRegistrar and discovers FeatureMetadata via ServiceLoader
FeatureProxyRegistrar registers a lazy singleton bean definition per discovered feature interface
META-INF/spring/org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.AutoConfiguration.imports contains com.flagzen.spring.FlagZenAutoConfiguration
flagzen-acceptance-tests/build.gradle.kts includes flagzen-spring and spring-boot-starter-test as testImplementation dependencies
flagzen-acceptance-tests cucumber.features includes flagzen-spring feature path
Developer can inject CheckoutFlow via @Autowired and calling a method dispatches to the correct variant
Scenario 'Developer injects a feature proxy and dispatches to the active variant' passes
steps.scenario_name: Developer injects a feature proxy and dispatches to the active variant

steps.name: Application starts with fallback provider when no FlagProvider defined
steps.description: Add InMemoryFlagProvider fallback bean creation to FlagZenAutoConfiguration with @ConditionalOnMissingBean(FlagProvider.class). Application starts without any explicit FlagProvider and dispatches to default variant.
criteria: FlagZenAutoConfiguration creates InMemoryFlagProvider fallback when no FlagProvider bean exists
InMemoryFlagProvider fallback has @ConditionalOnMissingBean(FlagProvider.class) guard
Injected proxy dispatches to default variant with fallback provider
Scenario 'Application starts with fallback provider when no explicit provider is defined' passes
steps.scenario_name: Application starts with fallback provider when no explicit provider is defined

steps.name: Custom dispatcher takes precedence over auto-configured one
steps.description: Verify @ConditionalOnMissingBean(FeatureDispatcher.class) on the auto-configured dispatcher bean. When user defines a custom FeatureDispatcher, auto-configuration backs off.
criteria: When a custom FeatureDispatcher bean is defined, auto-configuration does not create a second one
Only the custom FeatureDispatcher exists in the application context
Scenario 'Custom dispatcher takes precedence over auto-configured one' passes
steps.scenario_name: Custom dispatcher takes precedence over auto-configured one

phases.name: Auto-Configuration
phases.description: Complete FeatureDispatcher auto-configuration: explicit FlagProvider detection, back-off when custom dispatcher exists, Spring Boot imports discovery mechanism, profile-specific provider selection, ambiguous bean error handling, and cross-module FlagProvider auto-detection.

steps.name: FeatureDispatcher bean created from explicit FlagProvider bean
steps.description: Verify that when a named FlagProvider bean exists, FeatureDispatcher is auto-created using that specific provider.
criteria: FeatureDispatcher bean exists in the application context
FeatureDispatcher uses the named FlagProvider bean
Scenario 'FeatureDispatcher bean created from explicit FlagProvider bean' passes
steps.scenario_name: FeatureDispatcher bean created from explicit FlagProvider bean

steps.name: Auto-configuration backs off when FeatureDispatcher already exists
steps.description: Verify that when both a custom FeatureDispatcher and a FlagProvider bean exist, auto-configuration does not create a second dispatcher.
criteria: Only the custom FeatureDispatcher bean exists when both custom dispatcher and FlagProvider are defined
Auto-configuration does not create a second dispatcher
Scenario 'Auto-configuration backs off when FeatureDispatcher already exists' passes
steps.scenario_name: Auto-configuration backs off when FeatureDispatcher already exists

steps.name: Auto-configuration discovered via Spring Boot imports mechanism
steps.description: Verify that the AutoConfiguration.imports file is correctly structured and Spring Boot discovers FlagZenAutoConfiguration through it.
criteria: FlagZenAutoConfiguration is discovered and processed by Spring Boot auto-configuration scan
Scenario 'Auto-configuration discovered via Spring Boot imports mechanism' passes
steps.scenario_name: Auto-configuration discovered via Spring Boot imports mechanism

steps.name: Profile-specific FlagProvider is used for the active profile
steps.description: Verify Spring profile-based FlagProvider selection works with auto-configuration. When multiple FlagProviders are registered under different profiles, the active profile's provider is used.
criteria: FeatureDispatcher uses the FlagProvider associated with the active Spring profile
Scenario 'Profile-specific FlagProvider is used for the active profile' passes
steps.scenario_name: Profile-specific FlagProvider is used for the active profile

steps.name: Ambiguous FlagProvider beans fail with clear error
steps.description: Verify that when two FlagProvider beans exist without @Primary designation, the application fails to start with an error identifying both beans.
criteria: Application fails to start when two FlagProvider beans exist with no @Primary
Error message identifies both conflicting FlagProvider beans
Scenario 'Ambiguous FlagProvider beans fail with a clear error' passes
steps.scenario_name: Ambiguous FlagProvider beans fail with a clear error

steps.name: FlagProvider from another FlagZen module is auto-detected
steps.description: Verify that a FlagProvider bean registered by another module (e.g., flagzen-env) is automatically picked up by flagzen-spring auto-configuration with zero developer configuration.
criteria: FeatureDispatcher uses the FlagProvider from the other FlagZen module
Developer writes zero provider configuration code
Scenario 'FlagProvider from another FlagZen module is auto-detected' passes
steps.scenario_name: FlagProvider from another FlagZen module is auto-detected

phases.name: Feature Proxy Injection
phases.description: Complete feature proxy bean registration and injection: single proxy from metadata, multiple proxies, constructor injection, dynamic dispatch on flag change, and graceful handling of zero metadata.

steps.name: Feature proxy bean registered from discovered feature metadata
steps.description: Verify that FeatureProxyRegistrar discovers FeatureMetadata via ServiceLoader and registers the corresponding proxy bean in the application context.
criteria: CheckoutFlow bean is available in the application context
The bean is the dispatch proxy created by FeatureDispatcher
Scenario 'Feature proxy bean registered from discovered feature metadata' passes
steps.scenario_name: Feature proxy bean registered from discovered feature metadata

steps.name: Multiple feature proxy beans registered for multiple feature interfaces
steps.description: Verify that when multiple feature interfaces exist with generated metadata, each gets its own distinct proxy bean registered.
criteria: Both CheckoutFlow and ShippingMethod beans are available in the application context
Each bean is a distinct dispatch proxy
Scenario 'Multiple feature proxy beans registered for multiple feature interfaces' passes
steps.scenario_name: Multiple feature proxy beans registered for multiple feature interfaces

steps.name: Feature proxy injected via constructor autowiring
steps.description: Verify that a Spring service declaring a @Feature interface as a constructor dependency receives the FlagZen dispatch proxy.
criteria: PaymentService receives the FlagZen dispatch proxy via constructor injection
PaymentService can call methods on the injected CheckoutFlow
Scenario 'Feature proxy injected via constructor autowiring' passes
steps.scenario_name: Feature proxy injected via constructor autowiring

steps.name: Injected proxy dispatches dynamically as flag values change
steps.description: Verify that the injected proxy is not a snapshot -- when the underlying flag value changes, the same proxy dispatches to the new variant.
criteria: When flag value is CLASSIC, proxy dispatches to Classic variant
When flag value changes to EXPRESS, same proxy dispatches to Express variant
Scenario 'Injected proxy dispatches dynamically as flag values change' passes
steps.scenario_name: Injected proxy dispatches dynamically as flag values change

steps.name: No feature metadata found logs informational message and starts normally
steps.description: Verify graceful handling when ServiceLoader finds zero FeatureMetadata implementations. Application starts, no proxy beans registered, informational log emitted.
criteria: No feature proxy beans are registered when no FeatureMetadata exists
Application logs that no feature metadata was found
Application starts and runs successfully
Scenario 'No feature metadata found logs informational message and starts normally' passes
steps.scenario_name: No feature metadata found logs informational message and starts normally

phases.name: Fallback and Overrides
phases.description: Complete InMemoryFlagProvider fallback behavior with diagnostic warning, and @ConditionalOnMissingBean guard verification for all auto-configured beans: fallback creation, warning logging, default variant dispatch, no-fallback-when-explicit, custom provider override, custom dispatcher override, and full override scenario.

steps.name: Fallback provider created when no FlagProvider bean is defined
steps.description: Verify that InMemoryFlagProvider is created as a fallback when no FlagProvider bean exists, and FeatureDispatcher is created using it.
criteria: InMemoryFlagProvider fallback is active when no FlagProvider bean is defined
FeatureDispatcher bean is created using the fallback provider
Scenario 'Fallback provider created when no FlagProvider bean is defined' passes
steps.scenario_name: Fallback provider created when no FlagProvider bean is defined

steps.name: Warning logged when fallback provider is activated
steps.description: Verify that activating the InMemoryFlagProvider fallback emits a WARN log with specific messaging about missing provider and dev/test-only usage.
criteria: WARN log contains 'No FlagProvider bean found'
WARN log mentions 'InMemoryFlagProvider'
WARN log mentions 'dev/test only'
Scenario 'Warning logged when fallback provider is activated' passes
steps.scenario_name: Warning logged when fallback provider is activated

steps.name: Features dispatch to default variant with fallback provider
steps.description: Verify that with InMemoryFlagProvider fallback active, feature proxies dispatch to the default variant.
criteria: CheckoutFlow dispatches to default variant when fallback provider is active
Scenario 'Features dispatch to default variant with fallback provider' passes
steps.scenario_name: Features dispatch to default variant with fallback provider

steps.name: No fallback provider created when explicit FlagProvider exists
steps.description: Verify that InMemoryFlagProvider fallback is NOT created when an explicit FlagProvider bean is defined, and no warning is logged.
criteria: No InMemoryFlagProvider fallback is created when explicit provider exists
No 'No FlagProvider bean found' warning is logged
Scenario 'No fallback provider created when explicit FlagProvider exists' passes
steps.scenario_name: No fallback provider created when explicit FlagProvider exists

steps.name: Custom FlagProvider prevents fallback provider creation
steps.description: Verify @ConditionalOnMissingBean guard: custom FlagProvider bean causes auto-configuration to use it instead of creating fallback.
criteria: FeatureDispatcher uses the custom FlagProvider
No InMemoryFlagProvider fallback is created
Scenario 'Custom FlagProvider prevents fallback provider creation' passes
steps.scenario_name: Custom FlagProvider prevents fallback provider creation

steps.name: Feature proxy beans use custom FeatureDispatcher when provided
steps.description: Verify that when a custom FeatureDispatcher bean is defined, proxy beans are resolved through it rather than an auto-configured dispatcher.
criteria: CheckoutFlow proxy bean is resolved through the custom dispatcher
Scenario 'Feature proxy beans use custom FeatureDispatcher when provided' passes
steps.scenario_name: Feature proxy beans use custom FeatureDispatcher when provided

steps.name: Full override with all custom beans causes zero auto-configuration
steps.description: Verify that when the developer provides custom FlagProvider, custom FeatureDispatcher, and custom feature proxy beans, auto-configuration creates nothing.
criteria: Auto-configuration creates no beans when all custom beans are provided
All custom beans are used throughout the application
Scenario 'Full override with all custom beans causes zero auto-configuration' passes
steps.scenario_name: Full override with all custom beans causes zero auto-configuration

phases.name: Startup Diagnostics
phases.description: Startup logging: INFO summary with provider name, feature count, and feature names; zero-feature edge case; DEBUG per-feature registration logging.

steps.name: Startup summary logged with provider and feature details
steps.description: Add INFO-level startup summary to FlagZenAutoConfiguration that logs provider class name, registered feature count, and feature interface names.
criteria: INFO startup summary is logged after auto-configuration completes
Summary includes the provider class name
Summary lists the feature interface names
Summary includes the count of registered proxy beans
Scenario 'Startup summary logged with provider and feature details' passes
steps.scenario_name: Startup summary logged with provider and feature details

steps.name: Zero features logged clearly in startup summary
steps.description: Verify that when no feature interfaces exist, the startup summary indicates zero feature proxies registered without error.
criteria: Startup summary indicates zero feature proxies registered
Application starts successfully
Scenario 'Zero features logged clearly in startup summary' passes
steps.scenario_name: Zero features logged clearly in startup summary

steps.name: Individual feature registration logged at debug level
steps.description: Add DEBUG-level per-feature logging to FeatureProxyRegistrar that logs each feature interface name and its flag key during registration.
criteria: DEBUG message logs the registration of each feature interface
DEBUG message includes the flag key for the feature
Scenario 'Individual feature registration logged at debug level' passes
steps.scenario_name: Individual feature registration logged at debug level
